name: Compares the texts
tip: Compare as you go, with words like whereas or by contrast, not only in a last sentence.
description: Draws out similarities and differences in how the texts shape the idea, linked by comparative language.

name: Treats both texts in depth
tip: Give both texts equal depth: a technique and a detail from each, not one text closely and one briefly.
description: Gives each text the same depth of analysis, with apt evidence from both.
